cv.name: Femke Schoonhoven
cv.headline: Operations Manager | Supply Chain Planning | Port Logistics
cv.summary: Operations manager with six years in warehousing and supply chain planning around the port of Rotterdam. Equally at home running a distribution centre floor and building S&OP forecasts, and open to roles on either side.

experience.title: Operations Manager
bullets: Run day-to-day operations of a 42,000 m² bonded warehouse with 90 staff and temp workers
Improved order picking productivity by 18% after re-slotting fast movers
Own the operational budget, safety programme and client SLA reporting
Coordinate inbound container planning with terminals and carriers

experience.title: Supply Chain Planner
bullets: Prepared demand forecasts and the monthly S&OP cycle for 600 SKUs
Cut inventory days from 21 to 15 while keeping service level above 97%
Built planning reports in Power BI fed from SAP APO

experience.title: Logistics Trainee
bullets: Rotations in customs, freight forwarding and warehouse operations
